abstract_findings.finding: Aged individuals show decreased responses to influenza vaccination regardless of CMV serostatus.
Aged individuals show an overall down-regulation of immune components regardless of CMV serostatus.
Young CMV-infected adults show an overall up-regulation of immune components compared with uninfected young adults.
Young CMV-infected adults have enhanced antibody responses to influenza vaccination compared with uninfected young adults.
Young CMV-infected adults have increased CD8+ T cell sensitivity compared with uninfected young adults.
Young CMV-infected adults have elevated circulating IFN-γ levels compared with uninfected young adults.
Young mice infected with murine CMV are significantly protected from influenza virus challenge compared with uninfected mice.
The protective effect of murine CMV against influenza challenge in young mice declines with time.
